title: Mt.FUJI 100 — COURSE MAP (コースマップ)
claims: The course page is dated 1 September 2026 and links the GPX file 26FUJI100mi_ver.1.5.gpx for the FUJI100mi.
The page states that the GPX data is being corrected because of a course change on 9 April, and the Japanese page says the same for the elevation/progress chart and the detailed course map.
The English page shows a course map image named coursemap2027-fuji.jpg and states that it is being updated because of the course change on 9 April.
The page explains that many of the courses and venues are used with permission only during the event, so runners who want to train on the route are directed to four published test-run courses.

The four test-run courses are published as Strava routes 2944396810347488186, 2944399641245801764, 3480020451656145126 and 2944403968101089572, with a warning that high mountain sections may still hold snow.
The detailed course map is published as the PDF 26FUJI100MAALL_ver.1.5_.20260416.pdf, whose file name and date indicate the 2026 edition.
